name: 拉里·罗伯茨
bio_short: 美国计算机科学家，被誉为“ARPANET的总设计师”。作为ARPA的高级项目经理，他不仅设计了ARPANET的网络拓扑结构，还力排众议决定采用封包交换技术，并主导了整个项目的招标与建设实施。
bio_short_en: American computer scientist, recognized as the 'Chief Architect of the ARPANET'. As a program manager at ARPA, he not only designed the network topology of ARPANET but also insisted on using packet switching technology and led the entire project's contracting and implementation.
